exposure: gestational age (10 groups from 26 to 35 weeks)
cohort: The study included 177 healthy premature neonates with a gestational age of 26 to 35 weeks in southern Iran.
finding: The study established normal reference values for lateral ventricular size in preterm infants in Iran, with ventricular index increasing with gestational age and birth weight.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in ventricular dimensions between vaginal delivery and cesarean section.
